name: chop
description: Chop is volatility farming on Robinhood Chain (4663). Any token can be wrapped into a "log" (chTOKEN); every wrap, unwrap, buy and sell of a log pays a fee that is burned as log tokens (raising backing) or swapped into $CHOP, of which 20% is burned and 80% is paid to farmers. This skill lets an agent do everything with logs through Bankr: list and inspect logs, read backing, prices, historical farmer APR and wallet positions; wrap and unwrap; buy and sell log tokens; farm (two-sided or single-sided with just the paired token, e.g. WETH); stop farming into both tokens or one; stake and unstake LP; harvest $CHOP; process fees; scan for log-vs-market price gaps and plan arbitrage; and launch and seed new logs. Triggers on: "chop", "choplogs", "chop logs", "log token", "chTOKEN", "chCHOP", "chVRAX", "chQUOTIENT", "chAGENTOS", "wrap into a log", "unwrap my log", "farm the chop", "farm CHOP", "volatility farming", "harvest CHOP", "claim CHOP rewards", "single-sided WETH", "launch a log", "seed a log", "log arbitrage", "log gap", "log APR".
